graph.title: LEGO 40138 Christmas Train
notes: The two groups of pieces are intentional, not a missing connection. Set 40138 has two models. Pages 3-62 build the three-car train: locomotive b1-b80, tender b81-b142 and coach b143-b217. The tender and coach are coupled to the loco and to each other by towball joints. Pages 63-68 build a separate small scene: round base, tree, lamp post and flag, b218-b233. It starts from its own base plate on page 63 and is never fastened to the train. Page 69 only shows the two models standing side by side. Joining them with an edge would invent a connection the booklet does not make.

The parts list matches 233 pieces. The step-1 base plates of the locomotive and tender are the 2x6 white plate (lego-3795). The coach base is the 2x8 plate (lego-3034). The 3184 plates are the 1x4 towball plates.

The pictures are small and often upside down. Where it was unclear which exact plate a piece sits on, I picked the nearest plausible neighbour. This affects the 1x1 plates, tiles and clip tiles on the loco deck, the tender bed plates and the coach deck plates. Each piece is still joined to the sub-assembly it belongs to.

Most joins have null ports because exact stud positions cannot be read from the illustrations. Wheels are joined to the wheel-holder axle stubs (revolute). The loco bars are clipped into the 1x1 clip tiles, and the scene flag clips onto the black bar.
Couplings: the tender towball plate (b92) snaps into the loco rear socket plate (b13). The coach towball plate (b155) snaps into the tender rear socket plate (b87). Both are ball joints.
The tender's lollipop stick, ice-cream cone and cookies are only resting in the wagon bed (contact edges). The booklet shows no clear fastening for them.
The loco boiler sub-assembly (b58-b67) is attached to the cab through the black bracket b67. The attachment point (b41) is my best reading of the pictures.

Piece identification came from the element numbers on the parts page. The step-1 base plates of the locomotive and tender are the 2x6 white plate (lego-3795). The coach base is the 2x8 plate (lego-3034). The 3184 towball plates are the 1x4 plates with a ball.

The pictures are small and often upside down. Where it was unclear which exact plate a piece sits on, I picked the nearest plausible neighbour, so some stud-join targets are approximate, especially the 1x1 plates, tiles and clip tiles on the loco deck, the tender bed plates and the coach deck plates. Each piece is still joined to the sub-assembly it belongs to.

Most joins have null ports because exact stud positions are not readable from the illustrations. Wheels are joined to the wheel-holder axle stubs (revolute). The bars are clipped into the 1x1 clip tiles (loco) and the flag clip onto the black bar (scene).
Couplings: the tender towball plate (b92) snaps into the loco rear socket plate (b13). The coach towball plate (b155) snaps into the tender rear socket plate (b87). Both are ball joints.
The tender's lollipop stick, ice-cream cone and cookies are only resting in the wagon bed (contact edges). The booklet shows no clear fastening for them.
The loco boiler sub-assembly (b58-b67) is attached to the cab through the black bracket b67. The attachment point (b41) is my best reading of the pictures.
